mechanics.definition: 在没有任何现有单一Feature能够拥有完整生命周期时，以独立开始、结束和回报账本编排至少两种不同的已登记非Feature玩法动作；父节点只拥有外层阶段路由、完整路径、整周期回报和主要动作次数，不拥有局部随机或派奖。

conditional_packages.when: entry_source_semantics至少声明一个endogenous游戏内生入口来源；只有一个内生来源时保留退化支持不适用实例，两个及以上时评分

evidence_signatures: a stable cycle identity, explicit start and terminal events, and no additional wager inside the cycle are observable
stage_action_bindings cover every stage and bind all random or payout events to at least two distinct registered non-feature mechanic IDs
every branch is resolved by a deterministic control rule or an owned mechanic outcome, and the complete graph has a sealed finite termination proof
all cycle payouts are aggregated exactly once and every counted primary action is a resolved typed stage action
feature_cycle_owner_node_id points to this node and stage_action_count_projection exactly maps every finite canonical path to its completed typed-action count
exclusions: one free-spin, respin, hold-and-spin or award-draw lifecycle owns the complete cycle
the sequence only repeats stages or modes of one existing Feature mechanic
a child stage is itself a complete Feature cycle
a control stage produces unowned randomness or payout
player continue, accept, cash-out or skill decisions change the mathematical outcome
the sequence is only presentation, an ordinary paid-spin modifier, a cascade loop or cross-paid-entry persistent progress
